newsitem.title: USA: Search Capital gets $100 mln credit line.
newsitem.headline: Search Capital gets $100 mln credit line.

text.p: Search Capital Group Inc said Thursday it signed a letter of intent with an affiliate of Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc for a two-year $100 million revolving warehouse line of credit facility.
Search Capital said in exchange for the facility the company will offer Lehman common stock and warrants to buy additional shares of common stock upon the closing of the facility.
Search Capital is a specialized financial services company engaged in making non-prime automobile installment loans.
